item.title: Shrinkwrap 0.25.1
item.description: AI upscaling is now opt-in: add @upscale to a folder that should enlarge undersized sources, or turn it on for everything in Settings. @og, @favicon and @webclip upscale on their own, since their dimensions are fixed by the platforms that read them — @noupscale overrides. @crop is now an accepted spelling of the whole @fill family (@crop-top, @crop-nw, and the rest).
